source: Cholera Outbreak in Senegal in 2005 Was Climate a Factor PMC3432123
processing_notes: Source states: 'Among the bordering countries of Senegal in 2005... Gambia with 214 cholera cases' - interpreted as 214 sCh cases. processing_notes: Source states: 'Bathurst population at the time was 5000 while 1700 died of the cholera epidemic' - interpreted as approximately 5000 population with 1700 deaths (CFR approximately 34%).
